Good to know

How much notice do you need?

Catering orders need 24 hours' notice.

Is there a minimum order?

No. There's no minimum to place an order or to get it delivered.

Can you handle dietary restrictions?

We'll do our best with gluten-free, vegan and allergy requests. Our Katy kitchen can accommodate a wide range of dietary needs. Call your location before ordering so we can talk it through.

Do you provide plates, napkins and cutlery?

They aren't included with catering orders. Call your location if you need them and we'll see what we can do.
